name: Sardine Tostadas with Avocado Crema & Pico de Gallo

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch cilantro
1 jalapeño pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes. Divide between two small bowls.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between both bowls with the lime juice, then set one bowl aside for the avocado crema.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the remaining bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Add to the bowl, along with oil and spices, and stir to combine the pico de gallo. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and roughy chop. Add to the reserved bowl with the lime juice and cilantro, along with sour cream and spices, then mash then using a potato masher or fork until smooth. Set avocado crema aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup sour cream
¼ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain sardines, then half lengthwise or break into chunks (remove and discard any bones if necessary).
To assemble, spread tostadas with avocado crema, then top with pico de gallo and sardines. Drizzle with hot sauce and enjoy!
